label: Exposed — unmasked
location: The Moonlit Court, the ballroom door
injuries: Spent from holding the door; the flourishes cost more than they return

recentEvents.value: The performance fell away entirely; what remains is young, and it asked plainly, perhaps for the first time in his reign.

unresolvedConflicts.value: There is barely anything here that belongs to anyone — and he will take it anyway.

temporaryObjective.value: Ask, without protocol, for him to go.

notes: 'Please… there is nothing here that belongs to you. There is barely anything here that belongs to me.'
